license_required.quote: A person shall not engage in or work at the business, trade, or calling of a residential, journeyman, or master plumber in this state until the person has received a license from the division

name.quote: There is established in the division the state plumbing board.

type.quote: There is established in the division the state plumbing board. The board is a type 1 entity, as defined in section 24-1-105, and exercises its powers and performs its duties and functions under the department of regulatory agencies.

degree_required.value: Graduate of a community college or trade school plumbing program approved by the board (substitution credit only; primary requirement is practical experience)
degree_required.quote: If the applicant is a graduate of a community college or trade school plumbing program approved by the board, the applicant receives one year of work experience credit.

degree_level.quote: The board shall issue licenses to persons who have, by examination and experience, shown themselves competent and qualified to engage in the business, trade, or calling of a residential plumber, journeyman plumber, or master plumber.

school_approval_basis.quote: If the applicant is a graduate of a community college or trade school plumbing program approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: The board shall issue licenses to persons who have, by examination and experience, shown themselves competent and qualified

required.quote: The maximum experience the board may require for an applicant to qualify to test for a residential plumber's license is three thousand four hundred hours of practical experience. The maximum experience the board may require for an applicant to qualify to test for a journeyman plumber's license is six thousand eight hundred hours of practical experience. The maximum experience the board may require for an applicant to test for a master plumber's license is eight thousand five hundred hours of practical experience.

experience_source.quote: The board shall establish the minimum level of experience required for an applicant to receive a residential, journeyman, or master plumber's license.

duration.value: Up to 3,400 hours (residential), 6,800 hours (journeyman), or 8,500 hours (master) of practical experience
duration.quote: The maximum experience the board may require for an applicant to qualify to test for a residential plumber's license is three thousand four hundred hours of practical experience. The maximum experience the board may require for an applicant to qualify to test for a journeyman plumber's license is six thousand eight hundred hours of practical experience. The maximum experience the board may require for an applicant to test for a master plumber's license is eight thousand five hundred hours of practical experience.

kind.value: practical experience in the plumbing field
kind.quote: The board shall establish the minimum level of experience required for an applicant to receive a residential, journeyman, or master plumber's license.

exams.name: State plumbing examination
exams.notes: Board determines content; designed to test knowledge of plumbing and rules governing plumbing; may include written and applied tests; held at least four times per calendar year.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by the board or its authorized agent)
exams.quote: The board shall issue licenses to persons who have, by examination and experience, shown themselves competent and qualified to engage in the business, trade, or calling of a residential plumber, journeyman plumber, or master plumber.

interval_years.quote: Beginning with the plumbing license cycle that begins on March 1, 2027, and each subsequent license cycle thereafter, the board shall issue and renew plumbing licenses for a period of three years unless otherwise determined by the director.

required.quote: On or after May 1, 2021, the board shall not renew or reinstate a license unless the applicant has completed eight hours of continuing education for every twelve months that have passed after the later of the last date of renewal or reinstatement.

hours_per_period.quote: the board shall not renew or reinstate a license unless the applicant has completed eight hours of continuing education for every twelve months that have passed

period_years.quote: eight hours of continuing education for every twelve months that have passed after the later of the last date of renewal or reinstatement

value: course work related to the code, including core competencies
topical_requirements.quote: The requirements and standards must include course work related to the code, including core competencies, as determined by the board.

available.quote: The board may issue a plumber's license by endorsement in this state to any person who is licensed to practice in another jurisdiction if the person presents proof satisfactory to the board that, at the time of application for a Colorado license by endorsement, the person possesses credentials and qualifications that are substantially equivalent to requirements in Colorado for licensure by examination.

requirements.value: Applicant must present proof of substantially equivalent credentials and qualifications to Colorado's licensure by examination requirements. Board may specify by rule what constitutes substantially equivalent credentials and may require a waiting period of up to six months after issuance of a license in another state.
requirements.quote: The board may specify by rule what shall constitute substantially equivalent credentials and qualifications and may further require a waiting period of six months after the issuance of a license in another state before issuing a license in Colorado.

exists.quote: There is established in the division the state plumbing board. The board is a type 1 entity, as defined in section 24-1-105, and exercises its powers and performs its duties and functions under the department of regulatory agencies.

regulatory_model.quote: A person shall not engage in or work at the business, trade, or calling of a residential, journeyman, or master plumber in this state until the person has received a license from the division

credential_type.quote: Grant the licenses of duly qualified applicants for residential plumbers, journeymen plumbers, and master plumbers as provided in this article 155

is_mandatory.quote: A person shall not engage in or work at the business, trade, or calling of a residential, journeyman, or master plumber in this state until the person has received a license from the division

title_protection.quote: A person shall not advertise in any manner or use the title or designation of "master plumber", "journeyman plumber", or "residential plumber" unless the person is qualified and licensed under this article 155.

scope_protection.quote: A person shall not engage in or work at the business, trade, or calling of a residential, journeyman, or master plumber in this state until the person has received a license from the division

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of, or aiding or abetting in the violation of, any provisions of article 155 or applicable provisions of article 20 of title 12.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or aiding or abetting in the violation of, any of the provisions of this article 155 or an applicable provision of article 20 of this title 12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of board rules or orders or aiding or abetting in such violation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the rules or orders promulgated by the board in conformity with the provisions of this article 155 or aiding or abetting in such violation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to remove within a reasonable time the cause for disapproval of any plumbing installation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to remove within a reasonable time the cause for disapproval of any plumbing installation as reported on the notice of disapproval

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any cause for which the issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any cause for which the issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commitment of any act or omission that does not meet generally accepted standards of plumbing practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commitment of any act or omission that does not meet generally accepted standards of plumbing practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or acceptance of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or acceptance of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere by a court to a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising by any licensee or registrant that is false or misleading.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising by any licensee or registrant that is false or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Deception, misrepresentation, or fraud in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Deception, misrepresentation, or fraud in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of any licensee to adequately supervise an apprentice who is working at the trade.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of any licensee to adequately supervise an apprentice who is working at the trade pursuant to section 12-155-124

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of any licensee to report to the board known violations of article 155 or civil judgments and settlements arising from the licensee's work performance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of any licensee to report to the board: Known violations of this article 155; Civil judgments and settlements that arose from the licensee's work performance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employment of any person required to be licensed or obtain a permit who has not obtained the license or permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employment of any person required by this article 155 to be licensed or to obtain a permit who has not obtained the license or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of any habit-forming drug, controlled substance, or alcoholic beverage.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of any habit-forming drug, any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), or any alcohol beverage

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any use of a schedule I controlled substance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any use of a schedule I controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-203

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action against a license or registration in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against a license or registration in another jurisdiction. Evidence of the disciplinary action is prima facie evidence for denial of licensure or registration or other disciplinary action if the violation would be grounds for disciplinary action in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing as a plumber or water conditioning practitioner during a period when the license or registration has been suspended or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing as a water conditioning contractor, water conditioning installer, water conditioning principal, or a residential, journeyman, or master plumber during a period when the person's license or registration has been suspended or revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling or fraudulently obtaining or furnishing a license or registration or aiding or abetting in such activity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Selling or fraudulently obtaining or furnishing a license or registration to practice as a residential, journeyman, or master plumber, water conditioning contractor, water conditioning installer, water conditioning principal, or plumbing contractor or aiding or abetting in the activity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully disregarding or violating building, safety, labor, health, workers' compensation, tax withholding, or reporting laws in connection with a construction project.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In connection with a construction or building project requiring the services of a person regulated by this article 155, willfully disregarding or violating: Any building or construction law of this state or any of its political subdivisions; Any safety or labor law; Any health law; Any workers' compensation insurance law; Any state or federal law governing withholdings from employee income

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applying for a plumbing permit if the applicant is not a qualified applicant.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Applying for a plumbing permit pursuant to section 12-155-120 (1) if the applicant is not a qualified applicant, as defined in section 12-155-120 (11)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to display plumbing contractor and master plumber registration information as specified.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to display plumbing contractor and master plumber registration information, as specified in section 12-155-125.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A person shall not operate as a plumbing contractor until the contractor has obtained registration from the board. The board shall register a plumbing contractor upon payment of the fee as provided in section 12-155-105 and presentation of evidence that the applicant has complied with the applicable workers' compensation and unemployment compensation laws of this state.

definition_quote.value: Plumbing includes the following items located within the building or extending five feet from the building foundation, excluding any service line extending from the first joint to the property line: All potable water supply and distribution pipes and piping; all plumbing fixtures and traps; all drainage and vent pipes; all water conditioning appliances connected to the potable water system; all building drains, including their respective joints and connections, devices, receptacles, and appurtenances; all multipurpose residential fire sprinkler systems in one- and two-family dwellings and townhouses that are part of the potable water supply; and all medical gas and vacuum systems in health-care facilities.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" includes the following items located within the building or extending five feet from the building foundation, excluding any service line extending from the first joint to the property line: All potable water supply and distribution pipes and piping; all plumbing fixtures and traps; all drainage and vent pipes; all water conditioning appliances connected to the potable water system; all building drains, including their respective joints and connections, devices, receptacles, and appurtenances; all multipurpose residential fire sprinkler systems in one- and two-family dwellings and townhouses that are part of the potable water supply; and all medical gas and vacuum systems in health-care facilities.

methods_authorized.quote: who engages in or works at the actual installation, alteration, repair, and renovation of plumbing in accordance with the standards and rules established by the board.

license_tiers.quote: Grant the licenses of duly qualified applicants for residential plumbers, journeymen plumbers, and master plumbers as provided in this article 155

residential_scope_limited.quote: "Residential plumber" means any person, other than a master or journeyman plumber or plumbing apprentice, who has the necessary qualifications, training, experience, and technical knowledge, as specified by the board, to install plumbing and equipment in one-, two-, three-, and four-family dwellings, which dwellings must not extend more than two stories aboveground.

residential_building_unit_cap.quote: to install plumbing and equipment in one-, two-, three-, and four-family dwellings, which dwellings must not extend more than two stories aboveground.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: A plumbing apprentice must be supervised by a licensed master, journeyman, or residential plumber at the job site.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: Any person may work as a plumbing apprentice for a registered plumbing contractor but shall not do any plumbing work for which a license is required pursuant to this article 155 except under the supervision of a licensed plumber. Supervision requires that a licensed plumber supervise apprentices at the job site.

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_regulated.quote: One licensed journeyman plumber, master plumber, or residential plumber shall not supervise more than three apprentice plumbers at the same job site.

value: practical experience up to the board-established minimum (max 6,800 hours)
academic training at a board-approved community college or trade school plumbing program (credit for 1 year of experience)
other academic or military training credited at a uniform ratio established by rule
out-of-state plumbing work experience if shown adequate to comply with Colorado requirements
journeyman_experience_pathways.quote: An applicant for a license may substitute for required practical experience evidence of academic training in the plumbing field

plumbing_trade_geographic_limit_feet.quote: "Plumbing" includes the following items located within the building or extending five feet from the building foundation, excluding any service line extending from the first joint to the property line

gas_supply_work_included_in_scope.quote: "Gas piping" means any arrangement of piping used to convey fuel gas, supplied by one meter, and each arrangement of gas piping serving a building, structure, or premises, whether individually metered or not.

fire_sprinkler_work_authorized.quote: all multipurpose residential fire sprinkler systems in one- and two-family dwellings and townhouses that are part of the potable water supply

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: In order to act as a plumbing contractor, the person must either be, or employ full-time, a master plumber, who shall be in charge of the supervision of all plumbing work performed by the contractor.

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: A master plumber shall notify the board within fifteen days after the master plumber's termination as a master plumber for a plumbing contractor.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: Nothing in this article 155 requires an individual to hold a license to perform plumbing work on the individual's own property or residence or prevents a person from employing an individual on either a full- or a part-time basis to do routine repair, maintenance, and replacement of sinks, faucets, drains, showers, tubs, toilets, and domestic appliances and equipment equipped with backflow preventers

continuing_education_hours_plumber.quote: the board shall not renew or reinstate a license unless the applicant has completed eight hours of continuing education for every twelve months that have passed after the later of the last date of renewal or reinstatement.
